svg.title: Copilot Where the Content Lives
svg.desc: Microsoft 365 apps matched to their Copilot strengths: Word drafts and rewrites, Excel analyses and charts, PowerPoint builds decks from documents, Outlook summarises threads and drafts replies, Teams recaps meetings, and Pages keeps a shared AI canvas.
svg.text: Open Copilot in the app that already holds the task's material.
Deck from a prompt or a Word doc
Team keeps building on AI output
